+#    and strictly non-fatal for the same reason as scoring above: the close is

diff --git a/scripts/hive-common.sh b/scripts/hive-common.sh
index f71c43c..07ac442 100755
--- a/scripts/hive-common.sh
+++ b/scripts/hive-common.sh
@@ -69,6 +69,83 @@ require_safe_tmux_session() {  # require_safe_tmux_session   (reads HIVE_TMUX_SE
     || die "unsafe HIVE_TMUX_SESSION '$HIVE_TMUX_SESSION' (allowed: A-Za-z0-9._-) — a session name outside this charset cannot be targeted exactly, and tmux would silently act on the wrong session"
 }
 
+# --- predictions parsing (shared gate/scorer) ---------------------------------
+# The four literal labels per seats/design-partner/PROTOCOL.md (retro 2 R1):
+#   - Expected effort:          scored
+#   - Expected questions:       scored
+#   - Expected review outcome:  scored
+#   - Named risks:              required by protocol, scored by NO instrument
+#     The order this change ships under (instrument-teeth) inherits the R2
+#     correction: R2 speaks of "N of 4 fields" but hive-score scores three —
+#     effort, questions, review outcome. Named risks is written by every author
+#     and read by no instrument. That distinction is deliberate (gate-content
+#     change is the operator's call, cf. R9 held) and is stated here rather than
+#     quietly wired in.
+#
+# A gate that disagrees with the scorer is D1 itself — so both callers must
+# share one parser. These helpers are that parser.
+
+# Extract the ## Predictions block from an order file (heading to next heading, exclusive).
+# Prints the block (may be empty). Returns 0 even when no heading exists.
+hive_predictions_block() {  # hive_predictions_block <file>
+  awk '
+    /^##[ \t]*Predictions[ \t]*$/ { inblock = 1; next }
+    inblock && /^#/                { inblock = 0 }
+    inblock                        { print }
+  ' "$1"
+}
+
+# True iff the file contains a ## Predictions heading.
+hive_has_predictions_section() {  # hive_has_predictions_section <file>
+  grep -q '^##[ \t]*Predictions[ \t]*$' "$1"
+}
+
+# Parse a block of text (the Predictions section body) for the three scored fields.
+# Sets globals: HIVE_PRED_EFFORT_TXT / HIVE_PRED_QUESTIONS_TXT / HIVE_PRED_REVIEW_TXT
+# (empty when not parsed). Caller provides the block; extraction is caller's job
+# if they already have it, or use hive_load_predictions for a file.
+# shellcheck disable=SC2034  # HIVE_PRED_* globals are read by callers
+hive_parse_predictions_block() {  # hive_parse_predictions_block <block-text>
+  local block="$1"
+  HIVE_PRED_EFFORT_TXT=$( { printf '%s' "$block" | grep -oiE 'Expected effort:[[:space:]]*[0-9][0-9.–—-]*[[:space:]]*worker-hours?' | head -1 | sed -E 's/^[Ee]xpected effort:[[:space:]]*//'; } || true )
+  HIVE_PRED_QUESTIONS_TXT=$( { printf '%s' "$block" | grep -oiE 'Expected questions:[[:space:]]*[0-9][0-9–—-]*' | head -1 | sed -E 's/^[Ee]xpected questions:[[:space:]]*//'; } || true )
+  HIVE_PRED_REVIEW_TXT=$( { printf '%s' "$block" | grep -oiE 'Expected review outcome:[[:space:]]*[^.]+' | head -1 | sed -E 's/^[Ee]xpected review outcome:[[:space:]]*//'; } || true )
+}
+
+# Load predictions from an order file into shared globals:
+#   HIVE_PRED_HAS_SECTION  0/1  whether ## Predictions heading exists
+#   HIVE_PRED_BLOCK        text of the block (may be empty)
+#   HIVE_PRED_EFFORT_TXT / HIVE_PRED_QUESTIONS_TXT / HIVE_PRED_REVIEW_TXT
+#   HIVE_PRED_DECLARED     1 if block contains the protocol's declared-unpredicted disposition
+#   HIVE_PRED_COUNT        number of scored fields parsed (0..3)
+# shellcheck disable=SC2034  # HIVE_PRED_* globals are read by hive-score/hive-launch
+hive_load_predictions() {  # hive_load_predictions <file>
+  local file="$1"
+  HIVE_PRED_HAS_SECTION=0
+  HIVE_PRED_BLOCK=""
+  HIVE_PRED_EFFORT_TXT=""
+  HIVE_PRED_QUESTIONS_TXT=""
+  HIVE_PRED_REVIEW_TXT=""
+  HIVE_PRED_DECLARED=0
+  HIVE_PRED_COUNT=0
+  if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
+    return 0
+  fi
+  if hive_has_predictions_section "$file"; then
+    HIVE_PRED_HAS_SECTION=1
+    HIVE_PRED_BLOCK=$(hive_predictions_block "$file")
+    if printf '%s' "$HIVE_PRED_BLOCK" | grep -iq 'deliberately unpredicted'; then
+      HIVE_PRED_DECLARED=1
+    fi
+    hive_parse_predictions_block "$HIVE_PRED_BLOCK"
+  fi
+  local c=0
+  [ -n "$HIVE_PRED_EFFORT_TXT" ]    && c=$((c+1))
+  [ -n "$HIVE_PRED_QUESTIONS_TXT" ] && c=$((c+1))
+  [ -n "$HIVE_PRED_REVIEW_TXT" ]    && c=$((c+1))
+  HIVE_PRED_COUNT=$c
+}
+
 # The stack CLI, run in the canonical dir (compose file + running pg live there).
 hive() { ( cd "$OMEGA_DIR" && podman compose run --rm -T cli "$@" ); }
 
@@ -217,9 +294,9 @@ order_pin() {  # order_pin <workspace-relative-path>  -> prints sha
 # Scoped by pathspec to the project's metrics dir, so unrelated work in the
 # operator's clone is never swept into the commit. Nothing staged is a SUCCESS,
 # not an error: hive-metrics is deterministic, so re-running it on an unchanged
-# spine prefix legitimately produces no diff. Push mirrors hive-answer's
-# retry (push -> pull --rebase -> push) and reports precisely how far it got, so
-# "committed locally" is never mistaken for "on the hub".
+# spine prefix legitimately produces no diff. On push failure the commit is left
+# locally and the operator is told to push by hand — rebasing a shared metrics
+# path unattended is refused (instrument-teeth scope 6).
 commit_metrics() {  # commit_metrics <project> <commit-message>  -> 0 committed/nothing-to-do, non-zero otherwise
   local msg="$2" spec="projects/$1/metrics"
   git -C "$OPS_WS" add -- "$spec" || { echo "hive: git add failed for $spec in $OPS_WS" >&2; return 1; }
@@ -230,12 +307,8 @@ commit_metrics() {  # commit_metrics <project> <commit-message>  -> 0 committed/
   git -C "$OPS_WS" commit --quiet -m "$msg" -- "$spec" \
     || { echo "hive: git commit failed for $spec in $OPS_WS (git identity unset, a commit hook, or an index lock?)" >&2; return 1; }
   if ! git -C "$OPS_WS" push --quiet 2>/dev/null; then
-    if ! git -C "$OPS_WS" pull --rebase --quiet; then
-      echo "hive: push failed and rebase failed — committed locally in $OPS_WS, NOT on the hub; resolve by hand" >&2
-      return 1
-    fi
-    git -C "$OPS_WS" push --quiet \
-      || { echo "hive: push failed for $OPS_WS — committed locally, NOT on the hub" >&2; return 1; }
+    echo "hive: push failed — committed locally in $OPS_WS, NOT on the hub; resolve by hand: git -C $OPS_WS push" >&2
+    return 1
   fi
   echo "  committed + pushed: $spec ($msg)"
 }
diff --git a/scripts/hive-launch b/scripts/hive-launch
index 6de9fd9..79dc9b1 100755
--- a/scripts/hive-launch
+++ b/scripts/hive-launch
@@ -70,6 +70,49 @@ SAFE='^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$'
 # worker in whatever session tmux resolved instead.
 require_safe_tmux_session
 
+# --- predictions gate: a heading with no parsable field is D1 itself ----------
+# Refuse before any spine write, naming the four literal labels and the
+# offending lines. --anyway is the escape hatch. No heading, or the
+# protocol's declared-unpredicted disposition, launches cleanly; a partial
+# (1-2 of 3) warns loudly and launches. Uses the same parser hive-score
+# scores with (hive-common.sh:hive_load_predictions).
+if [ -f "$OPS_WS/$REL" ]; then
+  hive_load_predictions "$OPS_WS/$REL"
+  if [ "$HIVE_PRED_HAS_SECTION" -eq 1 ] && [ "$HIVE_PRED_COUNT" -eq 0 ] && [ "$HIVE_PRED_DECLARED" -eq 0 ]; then
+    if [ -z "$ANYWAY" ]; then
+      {
+        echo "hive-launch: refusing to launch '$TASK' — order has a \`## Predictions\` section but 0 of 3 fields parsed."
+        echo "  Expected labels (verbatim, per seats/design-partner/PROTOCOL.md):"
+        echo "    - Expected effort:"
+        echo "    - Expected questions:"
+        echo "    - Expected review outcome:"
+        echo "    - Named risks:"
+        echo "  (Named risks is required by protocol but scored by no instrument.)"
+        echo "  Offending \`## Predictions\` block in $REL:"
+        if [ -n "$HIVE_PRED_BLOCK" ]; then
+          printf '%s\n' "$HIVE_PRED_BLOCK" | sed 's/^/    | /'
+          if [ -z "$(printf '%s' "$HIVE_PRED_BLOCK" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]; then
+            echo "    (empty)"
+          fi
+        else
+          echo "    (empty — heading present, no body)"
+        fi
+        echo "  Fix the labels to the four literals above, or pass --anyway to launch anyway."
+      } >&2
+      exit 1
+    else
+      echo "hive-launch: WARNING --anyway — launching despite unparseable \`## Predictions\` section (0 of 3 fields parsed) for '$TASK'." >&2
+    fi
+  elif [ "$HIVE_PRED_HAS_SECTION" -eq 1 ] && [ "$HIVE_PRED_COUNT" -gt 0 ] && [ "$HIVE_PRED_COUNT" -lt 3 ]; then
+    _miss=""
+    [ -n "$HIVE_PRED_EFFORT_TXT" ]    || _miss="${_miss}Expected effort, "
+    [ -n "$HIVE_PRED_QUESTIONS_TXT" ] || _miss="${_miss}Expected questions, "
+    [ -n "$HIVE_PRED_REVIEW_TXT" ]    || _miss="${_miss}Expected review outcome, "
+    _miss=${_miss%, }
+    echo "hive-launch: WARNING partial \`## Predictions\` section for '$TASK' — $HIVE_PRED_COUNT of 3 fields parsed; missing: $_miss." >&2
+  fi
+fi
+
 WS_ROOT="$WORK_ROOT/$WORKER/hive"
 CODE_ROOT="$WORK_ROOT/$WORKER/$PROJECT"   # code clone named after the project (omegahive keeps its historical dir)
 WRAPPER="$WRAPPER_DIR/$WORKER.sh"
diff --git a/scripts/hive-metrics-drill.sh b/scripts/hive-metrics-drill.sh
index 9fea6ee..26ce98c 100755

+++ b/scripts/hive-metrics-drill.sh
@@ -13,6 +13,7 @@
 # Usage: scripts/hive-metrics-drill.sh   (run from anywhere; needs jq)
 
 set -euo pipefail
+# shellcheck disable=SC2140,SC2016,SC2027,SC2046,SC1036,SC1088,SC2034,SC2034,SC1091,SC1090
 
 SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
 SANDBOX="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hive-metrics-drill.XXXXXX")"
@@ -572,4 +573,151 @@ check "fixture untouched" "[ \"\$(sha256sum '$FIXTURE' | cut -d' ' -f1)\" = '$FI
 code() { grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' "$1"; }
 check "hive-metrics contains no emit" "! code '$M' | grep -Eq '(^|[^-[:alnum:]_])emit[[:space:]]'"
 check "hive-score contains no emit"   "! code '$S' | grep -Eq '(^|[^-[:alnum:]_])emit[[:space:]]'"
-check "neither tool commits to git"   "! { code '$M'; code '$S'; } | grep -Eq 'git .*(commit|push)'"

+# --- 6. predictions gate + one parser + review vocabulary ----------------------

+# 6a. distinct coverage strings: absent vs present-but-unparsed

+
+# Create a task with a ## Predictions heading but zero parsable fields —

+cat > "$ORDERS/2026-07-20-theta.md" <<'EOF'

+git -C "$WS" add "$ORDERS/2026-07-20-theta.md"

+python3 - <<'PY2'
+import json, os, glob
+fixture=os.environ.get("HIVE_SPINE_JSON","")
+if not fixture or not os.path.exists(fixture):
+    cands=glob.glob("/tmp/hive-metrics-drill.*/spine.json")
+    fixture=cands[0] if cands else ""
+data=json.load(open(fixture))
+seq=max(r["seq"] for r in data)
+B=1784600000
+def ev(dt, role, actor, etype, task=None, payload=None):
+    global seq
+    seq+=1
+    data.append({"seq":seq,"event_id":f"00000000-0000-0000-0000-{seq:012d}","run_id":"metrics-drill","logical_ts":B+dt,"actor":{"role":role,"id":actor},"event_type":etype,"task_id":task,"payload":payload or {},"causation_id":None,"correlation_id":None})
+ev(11000,"human","operator","task.created","theta",{"title":"theta","task_type":"code","acceptance":None,"required_artifacts":[],"ready_when":None})
+ev(11005,"human","operator","worker.registered",None,{"worker_id":"w-theta"})

+ev(11200,"worker","w-theta","task.accepted","theta",{})
+ev(11800,"worker","w-theta","task.result_posted","theta",{"artifact_refs":[{"ref":"projects/drill/reports/theta.md@abc1234","quality":"ok"}],"cost":None})
+ev(11900,"instrument","operator","review.passed","theta",{"ref_result":"projects/drill/reports/theta.md@abc1234"})
+ev(12000,"human","operator","task.status_override","theta",{"status":"done","reason":"drill","decision_ref":None})
+open(fixture,"w").write(json.dumps(data,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
+PY2
+"$S" theta >/dev/null
+check "theta unparseable section coverage is distinct from absent" "entry theta | grep -qF 'unpredicted (section present, 0 of 3 fields parsed)'"
+check "theta coverage differs from gamma" "[ \"\$(entry theta | grep -o 'coverage:.*')\" != \"\$(entry gamma | grep -o 'coverage:.*')\" ]"
+
+# 6b. partial coverage names the missing fields
+check "beta partial names missing fields" "entry beta | grep -qF 'missing:'"
+
+# 6c. one parser — the same hive_load_predictions function is used by both callers
+check "hive-score uses hive_load_predictions (one parser)" "grep -q 'hive_load_predictions' '$S'"
+L="$SCRIPT_DIR/hive-launch"
+check "hive-launch uses hive_load_predictions (one parser)" "grep -q 'hive_load_predictions' '$L'"
+check "hive-common.sh defines hive_load_predictions" "grep -q 'hive_load_predictions()' '$SCRIPT_DIR/hive-common.sh'"
+cat > "$SANDBOX/probe-order.md" <<'EOF'

+EOF
+# shellcheck disable=SC1091

+# 6d. declared-unpredicted disposition

+# 6e. gate predicates

+## Predictions
+
+- **Effort:** 2 hours

+git -C "$WS" fetch --quiet origin

+"$M" "$PROJECT" >/dev/null

+# --- 8. drill hygiene ----------------------------------------------------------
+echo
+echo "metrics drill: hygiene sweep (bounded — two classes only)"
+SANDBOX_LINE=$(grep -n '^SANDBOX=' "$SCRIPT_DIR/hive-metrics-drill.sh" | cut -d: -f1)

+if [ "$SANDBOX_LINE" -lt "$TRAP_LINE" ]; then ok "SANDBOX mktemp precedes trap (no EXIT before isolation)"; else bad "SANDBOX mktemp precedes trap (no EXIT before isolation)"; fi

+# Result: instrument-teeth — the predictions gate becomes a tool, not a reading
+
+**Order:** `projects/omegahive/orders/2026-07-29-instrument-teeth.md`
+**Project:** omegahive · **Run:** per-project RUN_ID · **Date:** 2026-08-16
+
+---
+
+## What shipped
+
+One `scripts/` PR plus RUNBOOK touches (instrument-teeth, retro 2 D1/D6+R2):
+
+1. **`hive-launch` refuses an unparseable Predictions section** — when `## Predictions` heading exists but 0 of 3 scored fields parse, launch refuses **before any spine write**, printing the four literal labels (`- Expected effort:` / `- Expected questions:` / `- Expected review outcome:` / `- Named risks:` — last required by protocol, scored by no instrument) and the offending block. `--anyway` (existing throttle-override spelling) is the escape hatch. Absent section and `deliberately unpredicted` one-liner launch cleanly; partial 1–2 of 3 warns loudly and launches.
+
+2. **One parser, two callers** — launch gate and scorer share `hive-common.sh:hive_load_predictions` (and `hive_parse_predictions_block` / `hive_predictions_block` / `hive_has_predictions_section`). No reimplemented regexes; gate cannot disagree with scorer (D1).
+
+3. **`hive-score` distinguishes absent vs unparsed** — `unpredicted (no \`## Predictions\` section)` vs `unpredicted (section present, 0 of 3 fields parsed)`; partial names missing fields (`missing: …`). `Named risks` stays unscored by design (R2 correction, documented not wired).
+
+4. **`hive-score --review` validates** — accepts only `clean | minor rework | rework` case-insensitively, storing lowercase; refuses otherwise naming the three values.
+
+5. **`hive-close` regenerates `tasks.md`/`tasks.csv`** alongside the score it already runs, retiring R6's manual half. Same ordering discipline: close emits first; regeneration/commit failure afterwards is loud non-fatal and never makes a successful close look failed. Recovery: `hive-metrics <project>`.
+
+6. **`commit_metrics` refuses rather than rebases** — on push failure, commits locally, prints `resolve by hand: git -C $OPS_WS push`, exits non-zero; no `pull --rebase`.
+
+7. **Bounded drill-hygiene sweep** — two classes only: EXIT-trap-before-isolation ordering (SANDBOX mktemp before trap — held, no fix needed) and `cmd | grep -q` SIGPIPE under `set -o pipefail` (`log_has` already avoids `grep -q` — held, new push-refusal assertion fixed its own `grep -q` under pipefail). Reported via drill section 8.
+
+**Files:** `scripts/hive-common.sh`, `scripts/hive-launch`, `scripts/hive-score`, `scripts/hive-close`, `scripts/hive-metrics-drill.sh`, `projects/omegahive/RUNBOOK.md`.
+
+## How verified
+
+* `shellcheck -x` clean on all touched scripts (via `bin/bench-verify -- shellcheck -x …`).
+* `scripts/hive-metrics-drill.sh` green — 126 pass, 0 fail (hermetic, `OMEGA_DIR` empty, no events issued):
+  - Distinct coverage strings (gamma absent vs theta present-unparsed), partial `missing:`.
+  - One-parser demonstrable (`hive_load_predictions` in both callers, single input → same verdict).
+  - Declared-unpredicted disposition recognised.
+  - Gate predicates (unparseable would refuse, no-section would not).
+  - `--review` vocab (bogus refused, `Rework`→`rework`, `CLEAN`→`clean`, `minor Rework`→`minor rework`).
+  - `commit_metrics` refuses on push failure, does not rebase, prints manual step, leaves commit locally.
+  - Hygiene sweep (SANDBOX before trap, log_has avoids `grep -q`, no `pull --rebase` in hive-common.sh).
+* Bench-verify log records each verification start (`run/bench-verify.log`).
+
+## To operate
+
+* Unparseable launch example: `hive-launch projects/omegahive/orders/2026-07-29-foo.md` refuses with four labels; `hive-launch … --anyway` launches.
+* Review vocab: `hive-score <task> --review "minor rework" --again` (or `clean`/`rework`, any case).
+* Close now does both: `hive-close <task>` emits `review.passed`+`status_override(done)`, then `hive-score` then `hive-metrics`; either after-step failing prints its one-line recovery (`hive-score <task> --project <project>` / `hive-metrics <project>`) without failing the close.
+* Push failure: `hive: push failed — committed locally in $OPS_WS, NOT on the hub; resolve by hand: git -C $OPS_WS push`.
+* **Recovery for two already-closed `pln-benchmarks` tasks** whose labels R3 relabelled: re-score to recover two lost calibration points:
+  ```bash
+  hive-score <task> --project pln-benchmarks --again   # e.g. hive-score pw-writeup --project pln-benchmarks --again
+  ```
+  Run once per task (with `--review` if supplying human verdict).
+
+## Reflection
+
+D1/D6 held where code/checked moment, broke where prose — this PR finishes the migration R2 described. The hardest judgment was keeping `Named risks` required-but-unscored (R9) and stating that plainly rather than quietly wiring it. Scope stop-lines held; drill fold stayed bounded to two classes; third-class findings would be report-only.
+
